preview.overview: Notre Dame brings the lineal championship belt to Kenan Stadium looking to extend its dominance over North Carolina. The Tar Heels will need to break a brutal all-time curse against the Irish while the belt remains on the line in this ACC matchup.
key_matchups: Notre Dame's explosive offensive weapons vs. North Carolina's inconsistent defensive performance (allowing 42 to NC State, 32 to Duke)
North Carolina's ability to pressure Notre Dame's passing game after recording only 3 sacks in last 5 games
Weather conditions (partly cloudy, 77°F, low wind) favoring high-tempo offenses like Notre Dame's recent output
preview.betting_angles: Notre Dame has won 21 of 23 all-time meetings and is on a dominant 5-game tear with an average margin of victory exceeding 30 points. North Carolina's recent form shows three losses in its last four games, with wins only coming against inferior competition, suggesting the Irish's superior talent and consistency should prevail in favorable conditions.
preview.prediction_writeup: Notre Dame's recent dominance is undeniable—five straight wins with three of them being blowouts by 40+ points—while North Carolina has looked vulnerable to quality opponents, losing decisively to Clemson, NC State, and Duke. The head-to-head series tells an even starker story, with Notre Dame winning 21 of 23 matchups and consistently putting up 40+ points in their last three meetings. North Carolina's defense has shown it cannot match Notre Dame's offensive firepower, and the Tar Heels' own offense has failed to generate consistent scoring against ranked competition. The pleasant weather conditions at Kenan Stadium should only amplify Notre Dame's advantage, favoring the kind of wide-open, high-tempo game the Irish have mastered.
